info.title: abadge API
info.description: Public REST API for abadge — the credential control plane for AI agents. Store secrets, scope agent access, control delivery, and audit every attempt. All routes live under the `/v1` prefix and speak JSON. See the Introduction pages for authentication, errors, rate limiting, and pagination.

tags.name: Organizations
tags.description: Org-scoped isolation boundaries. Creating an org auto-seeds a default server-managed profile.

tags.name: API keys
tags.description: Personal API keys (`abu_`) for the management surface. Never reach `access.*`.

tags.name: Profiles
tags.description: Encryption boundaries within an org. Either zero-knowledge or server-managed.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Service accounts that authenticate via Ed25519 keypair sessions.

tags.name: Agent sessions
tags.description: Enrollment, challenge, and session exchange for keypair agents.

tags.name: Access
tags.description: Agent-facing secret access. Requires an `abs_` agent session token.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Append-only audit trail of every access attempt.

post.description: Creates an organization, the owner membership, and a default `server_managed` profile (`externalId: "default"`) in one transaction, so the org is immediately usable. Authenticated with a Better Auth session or personal API key.

get.description: Lists every organization the caller belongs to. Not paginated.

post.description: Creates a personal account — a single-member organization flagged personal via `organization.metadata`. Takes no request body; the name and slug are auto-generated from the user. Seeds the same default `server_managed` profile. The response is identical to `POST /orgs` with `organization.isPersonal: true`.

patch.description: Update the org name or logo. Requires the `admin` role.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the organization. Requires the `owner` role.

get.description: Lists members of the org. Email addresses are returned only to owners and admins; plain members see `email: null`. Not paginated.

post.description: Creates a token-based invitation. Returns an `abi_` invite token to share with the invitee. Requires the `admin` role.

delete.description: Removes a member and cascade-revokes their agents. Requires the `admin` role.

post.description: Accepts an invitation using its raw `abi_` token.

Creates a personal API key (`abu_`) bound to the caller and active org. The full secret is returned exactly once. A personal API key authenticates the management surface only — it can never reach `access.*` and cannot create or revoke other API keys, so this must be called from a browser-backed Better Auth session.

get.description: Lists the caller's personal API keys in the active org. Secrets are never returned. Not paginated.

delete.description: Revokes a personal API key. Must be called from a browser-backed Better Auth session.

post.description: Creates a profile in the org. A `zero_knowledge` profile must be bootstrapped separately before it can hold items. Requires the `admin` role.

get.description: Lists profiles in the org. Not paginated.

delete.description: Deletes a profile. Blocked while the profile still contains items (`PROFILE_NOT_EMPTY`). Requires the `admin` role.

post.description: Initializes a `zero_knowledge` profile with a client-derived wrapped root key and KDF parameters. The server never sees the password or root key. Requires the `admin` role.

Rotates a zero-knowledge profile's root key. The request must rewrap every item key under the new root key; omitting any item fails with `ROTATE_KEY_INCOMPLETE`. Returns the new `keyVersion`. Requires the `admin` role.

Creates an item in a profile. For zero-knowledge items supply a client-encrypted `encryptedItemKey` and `ciphertext`; for server-managed items supply a plaintext `payload` that the server encrypts with AES-256-GCM.

get.description: Lists item metadata in the active org. Cursor-paginated.
Returns item metadata. Zero-knowledge items also include the ciphertext envelope.

patch.description: Updates an item using optimistic concurrency. The request must carry the current `contentVersion`; a mismatch fails with `STALE_VERSION`. Requires the `admin` role.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an item and cascade-revokes its permissions. Requires the `admin` role.

post.description: Registers an agent. Agents authenticate with `public_key_session` (Ed25519). Provide a `publicKey` directly, or pass `issueBootstrapToken: true` to receive a one-time `abe_` enrollment token. Exactly one of the two is required. Requires the `admin` role.

get.description: Lists agents in the org. Cursor-paginated.

delete.description: Revokes an agent and cascade-revokes its permissions and active sessions. Requires the `admin` role.

post.description: Issues a one-time `abe_` enrollment token (10-minute TTL) for an existing keypair agent. Requires the `admin` role.
Redeems a bootstrap token and uploads the agent's Ed25519 public key (JWK). Unauthenticated — the bootstrap token is the credential.
Creates a short-lived `abc_` signing challenge (60-second TTL) for the agent to sign with its Ed25519 private key. Unauthenticated.

post.summary: Exchange a signed challenge for a session
post.description: Verifies the Ed25519 signature over the challenge and mints an `abs_` session token (15-minute TTL). Unauthenticated — the signature is the credential.

delete.description: Revokes an active `abs_` session for the current operator.

post.description: Creates one or more grants atomically — either every capability commits or none does. A grant targets exactly one of an item or a profile. Profile-target grants apply to every current and future item in that profile. Capabilities are `read` and `use`; legacy names (`read_ciphertext`, `reveal_plaintext`, `mount_env`, `mount_file`) are accepted and normalized. Requires the `admin` role.

get.description: Lists grants. Filter by `agentId`, `itemId`, or `profileId`. Cursor-paginated.

post.description: Reads a single item. Requires an `abs_` agent session and a `read` grant. Server-managed items return the decrypted payload; zero-knowledge items return the ciphertext envelope for the local daemon to decrypt. Every attempt — allowed or denied — is audited.

Reserves a one-shot mount handle for an item. Requires an `abs_` agent session, a `use` grant, and a local agent (no remote daemon). Returns an opaque `mountId` and `expiresAt` — never the plaintext. The daemon redeems the handle to inject the secret.

post.summary: Reserve mount handles for a profile
post.description: Reserves a mount handle for every item the agent has a `use` grant on within the profile (bulk env injection). Requires an `abs_` agent session and a local agent. Returns one handle entry per item.

Atomically consumes a mount handle and returns the decrypted payload (server-managed) or ciphertext envelope (zero-knowledge). One-shot: redemption deletes the reservation. Cross-agent or repeat redemption returns `NOT_FOUND` so reservations can't be probed. Used by the local daemon.

get.description: Lists audit events for the active org. Filter by `agentId`, `itemId`, `profileId`, `surface`, `field`, `eventType`, and `result`. Cursor-paginated, newest-first.
Returns `{ "status": "ok" }`. No authentication, excluded from rate limiting, and does not touch the database.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Management routes accept a Better Auth session token or a personal API key (`abu_`). Agent-facing `access.*` routes require an agent session token (`abs_`).

OrgIdHeader.name: X-Abadge-Org-Id
OrgIdHeader.description: Active organization. Required when the caller belongs to more than one org; otherwise resolved automatically.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor. Pass back the previous page's `nextCursor`.

Error.description: Standard error envelope. Every non-2xx response uses this shape.

hint.example: Verify the item ID and that it belongs to your organization.

issues.description: Present on `VALIDATION_ERROR`. One entry per failing field.

Capability.description: Canonical capabilities are `read` and `use`. The remaining values are legacy aliases that normalize to `read`/`use` server-side.

AuditEventType.description: Audit event type. See the Audit log concept page for the full catalog.

KdfParams.description: Argon2id KDF parameters used to derive the profile key-encryption key client-side.

ItemPayload.description: Cleartext secret payload for server-managed items. Never used for zero-knowledge items.

slug.description: Optional URL slug. Auto-generated when omitted.

email.description: Null for plain members viewing other members.

token.description: Raw `abi_` invite token. Shown once — share it with the invitee.

expiresAt.description: Optional absolute expiry. Non-expiring until revoked when omitted.

key.description: Full `abu_` secret. Returned exactly once at creation.

externalId.description: Optional stable customer-supplied identifier, unique per org.

wrappedRootKey.description: Root key wrapped client-side under the password-derived KEK.

encryptedItemKey.description: Item key rewrapped under the new root key.

rekeyedItems.description: Must include every item in the profile.

id.description: Client-generated UUID. Bound into the encryption AAD, so the server stores it verbatim.

profileId.description: Target zero-knowledge profile. Resolves the org's first ZK profile when omitted.

encryptedItemKey.description: DEK wrapped under the profile root key (XChaCha20-Poly1305).

expectedKeyVersion.description: Optional CAS guard against a concurrent key rotation.

profileId.description: Target server-managed profile. Resolves the org's default profile when omitted.

ItemDetail.description: Item metadata. Zero-knowledge items additionally include `encryptedItemKey` and `ciphertext`.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key in JWK format. Provide this OR `issueBootstrapToken`, not both.

issueBootstrapToken.description: Issue a one-time `abe_` enrollment token instead of supplying a key now.

bootstrapToken.description: Present only when `issueBootstrapToken` was true. Shown once.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key in JWK format.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the challenge.

CreatePermission.description: Target exactly one of an item or a profile.

field.description: Select a single named field from a multi-field item.

purpose.description: Optional reason recorded in the audit log.

envVarName.description: Override the injected environment variable name (env delivery).

mountId.description: Opaque one-shot handle. Redeem it via the daemon.
